title: Sr. Tech Lead - App Security & Compliance
description: Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. About the Role Securiti, now part of Veeam, builds the Data Command Center for data security, privacy, governance, and AI security. We are looking for a Staff Security Engineer to provide hands-on technical leadership across product and application security. You will shape secure architecture, strengthen the SDLC, lead vulnerability response, and help engineering teams ship secure cloud and AI capabilities at scale. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can move comfortably from threat models and pull requests to exploit validation, cloud security, software supply chain risk, and customer or auditor discussions. What You’ll Do Product & application security Own and evolve the secure SDLC across the Securiti portfolio, including threat modeling, design reviews, secure code review, and security testing. Provide security leadership for AI capabilities, including LLM-powered features, agents, copilots, prompt injection, retrieval leakage, permissions, and model supply chain risks. Tune and improve SAST, dependency, secrets, container, infrastructure, and SBOM controls so findings are actionable and integrated into engineering workflows. Lead product vulnerability response from reproduction and severity assessment through remediation, coordinated disclosure, CVE handling, and customer advisories. Perform targeted penetration testing and security research across applications, APIs, agents, connectors, and cloud services; scope and validate third-party testing. Strengthen software supply chain security through SBOMs, signed and reproducible builds, dependency governance, and secure release practices. Build reusable security libraries, reference implementations, hardening guidance, and developer enablement; help scale security through a Security Champions program. Track and communicate meaningful security metrics, including remediation time, critical/high findings, scan coverage, and engineering adoption. Product compliance & assurance Partner with engineering on technical controls and evidence supporting SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001/27701, ISO/IEC 42001, HIPAA, PCI, and FedRAMP Moderate readiness. Translate applicable requirements such as GDPR, CCPA, the EU AI Act, DORA, and NIS2 into practical engineering requirements and release criteria. Validate remediation of audit and penetration-test findings and escalate material risks when needed. Serve as a technical security partner for customer due diligence, audits, security questionnaires, AI-risk reviews, and executive briefings. Technical leadership Work across Engineering, Product, Platform, SRE, and Veeam Corporate Security to make security risk visible in architecture and roadmap decisions. Influence engineering standards and security strategy without relying on direct authority. Represent Securiti in technical discussions with customers, auditors, standards bodies, and the security research community. What You’ll Bring 8+ years in security, with substantial experience in application or product security for SaaS or cloud-native platforms. Strong coding and code-review skills in one or more languages such as Go, Python, Java, or TypeScript, with the ability to validate vulnerabilities and build security tooling. Deep knowledge of multi-tenant cloud security across AWS, Azure, or GCP, including IAM, Kubernetes, secrets, tenant isolation, and protection of sensitive customer data. Hands-on experience securing LLM-powered applications, including prompt injection, retrieval leakage, agent authorization, and model supply chain risks. Demonstrated experience building or materially improving a secure SDLC across multiple engineering teams. Experience leading vulnerability response or coordinated disclosure, including severity assessment, CVE processes, remediation, and customer communications. Practical knowledge of software supply chain security, including SBOM, signing, SLSA, and SSDF concepts. Working experience with security assurance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or FedRAMP. Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical risk clearly to engineers, executives, auditors, and customers. title: Director, Business Solutions
description: Headquarters: United States, Remote Our Mission: 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. Our People: People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. Director, Enterprise Applications Position Profile Function: Business Technology — Enterprise Applications Reporting line: Chief Security and Business Technology Officer Role Purpose Lead the strategy, delivery and continuous improvement of 6sense’s enterprise applications, turning business priorities into secure, scalable platforms and measurable outcomes. This is a business transformation leadership role—not simply an application administration or project delivery role. The Director will partner with Go-to-Market, Customer Success, Support, Finance, Legal and Partner Operations to simplify processes, strengthen data quality and controls, and improve how work gets done. AI fluency and applied AI delivery are core requirements: the role must identify where AI creates value, where conventional automation is better, and where human judgment must remain accountable. Responsibilities & Accountabilities 1. Enterprise Strategy & Business Partnership Own a business-aligned application roadmap and investment portfolio, balancing growth, operational efficiency, risk, user experience and technical debt. Partner with functional leaders to define business problems, accountable process owners, funding, expected benefits and adoption commitments before delivery begins. Run transparent prioritization and portfolio reviews; challenge low-value requests and communicate trade-offs, dependencies and decisions clearly. 2. AI-Enabled Business Transformation Build a prioritized portfolio of AI and automation opportunities across business workflows, starting with process redesign and data readiness rather than tool selection. Lead build-versus-buy-versus-configure decisions with Enterprise AI Engineering, application owners, Security, Legal and Finance. Set standards for discovery, prototypes, evaluation, user acceptance testing, rollout and value realization. Require evidence before moving pilots into production. Champion practical AI adoption through training, workflow changes and feedback loops; distinguish estimated benefits from validated outcomes. Ensure AI-enabled workflows have defined permissions, human approval points, monitoring, escalation and safe fallback paths. 3. Application Architecture, Delivery & Reliability Lead business solutions partners, delivery leaders, engineers and administrators through clear ownership, shared standards and sustainable delivery practices. Guide architecture for Salesforce and connected GTM and Finance systems, prioritizing maintainability, reusable integrations and trusted data flows. Establish disciplined release management, testing, documentation, incident response and recovery practices for business-critical applications. Reduce redundant tools, fragile integrations, legacy customizations and unsupported components; manage lifecycle and vendor dependencies. 4. Governance, Security & Financial Stewardship Partner with Security, Privacy and Legal to embed access controls, segregation of duties, auditability, data protection and risk reviews into delivery and operations. Align application AI use cases with 6sense’s AI Management System and applicable approval processes; document risks, controls and ownership before deployment. Own application budgets, license utilization, vendor performance and total cost of ownership; consider AI usage costs as well as subscription and integration costs. 5. Leadership & Operating Model Develop an accountable, learning-oriented team with strong business consulting, application engineering and applied AI capabilities. Build capacity plans and effective partnerships across distributed teams and service providers. Establish a product-oriented operating model that owns outcomes after launch, not just project completion. Provide executive-ready reporting on portfolio health, delivered value, reliability, spend, adoption and risk. Create quarterly OKRs. Required Skills & Experience AI Competency — Essential, Not Optional Applied delivery: Demonstrated experience taking an AI-enabled business workflow from discovery through production, adoption and measured results—not only personal use of AI tools. Solution judgment: Explain the trade-offs among deterministic automation, embedded SaaS AI, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic workflows; know when AI should not be used. Technical fluency: Understand large language model limitations, grounding, context design, APIs, integration platforms and permission-aware tool access. Be able to review prototypes and challenge architecture with engineering partners; model research expertise is not required. Evaluation and economics: Define representative test cases, quality thresholds, failure modes, human review requirements and production monitoring. Compare business value with implementation, usage, maintenance and oversight costs. Responsible AI: Recognize risks including inaccurate outputs, sensitive-data exposure, prompt injection, excessive permissions and overreliance. Translate risk findings into controls and deployment decisions with the appropriate specialists. Adoption leadership: Teach teams how to use approved AI capabilities responsibly, redesign workflows around them and validate sustained benefits. Enterprise Applications & Leadership Substantial progressive experience leading enterprise applications or business systems, including people leadership, portfolio ownership and cross-functional transformation. Strong Salesforce ecosystem knowledge and experience connecting revenue and finance processes across enterprise systems. Proven ability to translate ambiguous business needs into roadmaps, investment decisions and reliable delivery. Working knowledge of integration architecture, data governance, secure application lifecycle practices, change management and operational resilience. Commercial discipline in budgeting, vendor negotiations, licensing and value realization. Clear executive communication, strong stakeholder management and the ability to build trust while challenging assumptions. Relevant degree or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Experience Leadership in a SaaS or similarly fast-changing business environment. Experience with quote-to-cash, customer lifecycle and financial operations transformation. Exposure to Workato, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Claude Enterprise or comparable enterprise AI and automation capabilities; tool familiarity alone does not establish AI proficiency. Relevant application, architecture, change management or AI governance certifications. Success Measures Set baselines and agree targets with business owners after assessing the portfolio. The following are proposed measures, not existing commitments. Outcome Evidence of Success Business value Validated reduction in manual effort, process cycle time or rework; benefits confirmed by the business owner and separated from estimates. AI quality and adoption Useful production adoption, evaluation results, exception rates and sustained workflow improvements—not pilot counts alone. Platform health Service reliability, incident recovery, release quality and reductions in technical debt and integration failures. Governance and data Documented ownership, completed risk reviews, effective controls, audit readiness and improvements in critical data quality. Financial discipline Transparent portfolio spend, improved license utilization and realized value relative to total operating cost. Delivery and capability Predictable delivery, stakeholder confidence, clear accountability and stronger application and AI skills across the team. Initial Priorities First 30 days: Assess business priorities, application ownership, team capabilities, architecture, spend and critical risks; establish baseline measures. Days 31–60: Agree portfolio priorities, clarify decision rights with IT and Enterprise AI Engineering, and select a small set of high-value AI or automation opportunities. Days 61–90: Establish delivery and governance routines; advance a selected use case through evaluation and readiness review, with adoption and measurement plans. Base Salary Range: $211,085.25 - $309,591.70 . The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote Notice of Collection and Use of Personal Information for California Residents: California Recruitment Privacy Notice and Policy Our Benefits: Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces. We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds. Query Languages: Fluency in Gremlin , Cypher , and GraphQL . Infrastructure & Systems: Proven systems knowledge with hands-on experience packaging, deploying, and managing applications in Kubernetes . Graph Federation: Familiarity with concepts and tooling required for graph federation and distributed data retrieval. Performance Tuning: Strong track record of profiling database performance, analyzing bottlenecks, and executing structural data optimizations.   Bonus Skills   Multi-Tenant SaaS: Demonstrated experience building and scaling multi-tenant Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) applications.
